name: EmailListVerify
summary: Email deliverability checks (plain or detailed with MX, ESP, role and free flags), asynchronous high-quality jobs, disposable-domain and DNS blacklist checks, business email finding and credit balance.

api_key.description: An EmailListVerify API key (account dashboard > API). Sent in the x-api-key header.

notes: Results: ok (deliverable), ok_for_all (catch-all domain), unknown, antispam_system (blocked by anti-spam), email_disabled, dead_server, invalid_mx, invalid_syntax, smtp_protocol, disposable, spamtrap.
Credits come in two pools: on-demand credits never expire, daily subscription credits reset each day while the plan is active.
Rate limits are per endpoint and per second (10/s for the single checks, 5/s for contact finding); a 403 means the account is disabled.
Email list upload, download, Deep Scan re-verification, deletion and inbox placement tests are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Verify one email (status only)
endpoints.summary: The deliverability status of one address as plain text.
notes: 1 credit. Answers plain text, not JSON; the text error_credit means the balance is too low.

endpoints.name: Verify one email with details
endpoints.summary: Deliverability result plus internal result, MX server and IP, email provider (ESP), role, free and no-reply flags, and first name, last name and gender when found.

endpoints.name: Start an asynchronous email verification
endpoints.summary: Queues one address for verification at standard or high quality and returns a job id to poll.
notes: Starts a billed job: 1 credit at standard quality, 2 at high. It reads: the POST only queues a check of the address and changes nothing else.
Standard jobs take up to 1 minute, high-quality jobs up to 30 minutes (greylisting); fetch the result with emaillistverify.email.job_get.

endpoints.name: Get an asynchronous verification's result
endpoints.summary: Status of an email job and, once finished, its result and evaluated metadata.

id.description: The job id returned when the job was created.

notes: Free to poll; 100 requests per second.

endpoints.name: Check if an email domain is disposable
endpoints.summary: Whether a domain issues temporary addresses, plus a check of its MX/DNS setup: disposable, ok, dead_server, invalid_mx or unknown.
notes: 1 credit, none for an unknown result. A POST that only reads: it looks the domain up and stores nothing. 50 requests per second.

endpoints.name: Check an IP or domain against DNS blacklists
endpoints.summary: Which DNS-based blacklists list an IPv4, IPv6 address or domain, with listing details.

value.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address, or a domain; the type is detected.

notes: 10 credits (8 on Pro, 5 on Business). A POST that only reads: it queries public blacklists and changes nothing. 10 requests per second.

endpoints.name: Find a contact's business email
endpoints.summary: Candidate addresses at a company domain for a person (or common role addresses when no name is given), each verified and rated high, medium, low or unknown confidence.
notes: 5 credits when a first or last name is given, 10 for a domain alone (about twenty role addresses checked). A POST that only reads. 5 requests per second.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: On-demand credits left, and the subscription's daily credits left with their expiry.
